CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_punch_action(org uuid, request_id uuid, action text, job uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1 from mir_core.time_periods p
    where p.organization_id=org
      and current_date between p.starts_on and p.ends_on
      and p.status='locked'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Cette semaine est verrouillée; demandez une correction documentée' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  return public.mir_punch_action_phase1(org,request_id,action,job,payload);
end$function$
